push.title: W 1-0 vs NomNomFC | You: 7.4 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Soup_Kitchen22, your 2nd best match performance of the season with a 7.4 against NomNomFC. Hall of fame material, at least in my kitchen.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 23%). You picked their pocket and nobody even noticed.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 4. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season, at 7.4. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Passes attempted 16, up from your usual 11. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Win, 1-0, over NomNomFC. Keep the streak breathing.

THE BAD
- You and tuxedo_slide, same lesson: passing accuracy. Same answer: give each other short options.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 1. Note to self, from me to you.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). That's the leak in the boat.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 5). Repeat after me: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 44% (7 of 16). That's not a bad day, that's a warning siren. Real quick: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Five-minute drill: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

Listen here, Soup_Kitchen22: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

You played with joy, and joy is contagious. - Coach Lasso

One thought for the road, tuxedo_slide: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Proud of you. Go celebrate responsibly. - Coach Lasso
